description:
Data, scripts and results of a sentence-level topic model (BERTopic) of the normalized reading text of the digital edition of the memoirs of Luise Charlotte von Schwerin (1684–1732). The repository contains the preprocessing of the TEI/XML reading text, the BERTopic run and its output, the editorially curated topics (labels, assessment, related topics and subject headings), the topic assignments written back into TEI as stand-off annotation together with a TEI topic taxonomy, comparison runs with other embedding models and parameters, a manual coherence check, and a survey of thematic indexing in 26 digital editions.

It accompanies the article: Selina Galka: Thematische Erschließung in digitalen Editionen. Manuelle Beschlagwortung und Topic Modelling am Beispiel der Memoiren der Gräfin Schwerin. In: Zeitschrift für digitale Geisteswissenschaften (in preparation).

Licence: the data are published under CC BY-NC 4.0, like the edition text from which they are derived; the code (XSLT stylesheets, Python scripts, Jupyter notebooks) is published under the MIT licence (see LICENSE). The fitted BERTopic model is not part of this archive.
